newsitem.title: FRANCE: More cargo capacity on US Airways Paris-Philadephia.
newsitem.headline: More cargo capacity on US Airways Paris-Philadephia.

text.p: An upgrade in U.S. Airways U.N. Boeing 767-300 passenger service between Paris/CDG and Philadelphia will boost freight capacity on the route, the American carrier's French cargo sales agent, Globe Air Cargo, told Reuters.
"U.S. Airways is to double its daily frequency on the route from June 15 and the extra flight will be able to accomodate around ten tonnes of air cargo," a Globe Air official said

"While Philadelphia is a not a particularly important cargo destination in itself, it does serve as a hub for the north-east of the U.S.," he noted. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
